With its special purple coloring actives and UV Filter, it helps to prevent the formation of unwanted orange tones and color losses in the hair. With its herbal Keratin content, it provides protection, repair and resistance support against hair wear. It provides silky softness and easy combing. Contains UV filter. Paraben free. It has vegan content. No animal ingredients were used.Â
